envelope.description: HANDLING_TABLE, the admission rule and the output caps

body.title: HANDLING_TABLE, the admission rule and the output caps
body.summary: Add the size-to-method table (undetermined is XL), the two-unit admission rule (CLI characters minus 16,000; local UTF-8 bytes against window minus output tokens minus 2,048; default 60,000), PART_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS 8,192 for local part and combine calls, and the trigger decision (size, fit, both) with the budgets it records.
acceptanceChecks: a local single pass is admitted at exactly 10,240 bytes and divided one byte over, with multi-byte text counted in bytes
the real code, adherence and docs prompt sizes give the stated single-pass decisions and every part prompt plus the minimum room fits 22,528 bytes
a CLI provider is admitted in characters and the units are never compared
a window that leaves less than the fixed context plus 4,000 bytes raises HandlingBudgetError naming the configuration

tests.name: handling-table.test.ts: XS and S single pass, M, L and XL partitioned, undetermined is XL, trigger size/fit/both and no trigger for single pass
handling-admission.test.ts: checked-in local values give 10,240 bytes, exact boundary, one byte over, multi-byte, 22,528 for parts, window too small gives HandlingBudgetError naming the configuration
handling-admission.test.ts: real code, adherence and docs prompt sizes, CLI characters minus 16,000, units never compared, local code and adherence handled in parts with trigger 'fit'
part-output-cap.test.ts: PART_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS 8,192 for local part and combine calls, configured tokens for single pass, no enforced cap for CLI
